requirements.quote: Per signal and source: time from signal to issue, to merge and to deployed-verified, plus false-positive rate (issues closed as invalid), fix-ineffective rate (reopened after deploy) and recurrence rate.
Emit them through the telemetry seam (bin/engine/telemetry-seam.mjs).
`sourceMode(source, stats)` drops a source to shadow (triage runs, nothing is filed) when its false-positive rate stays above a threshold over a minimum sample.
Loop metrics plus an automatic drop to shadow.

Rules: pure functions with an injected `io` (exec/gh/llm/now) like bin/lean/issuewatch.mjs; read-only by contract; deterministic first; core stays repo-agnostic (#1347). Repo is PUBLIC: no raw customer data in fixtures.

deliverables.change: New pure module: computeMetrics(rows, now) per source (median signal-to-issue/merge/verified, FP, fix-ineffective, recurrence rates), sourceMode(source, stats, opts) returning {mode, gated, rate} like effectiveMode (min sample 5, threshold 0.5 default), emitMetrics(metrics, io) emitting PRODWATCH_METRICS records. No gh/fs; injected io.
mapRecord branch PRODWATCH_METRICS -> prodwatch_metrics (source, counts, rates, medians via compact()); add doc-comment line.
Tests: metrics math, empty/missing timestamps, shadow below/above min sample and threshold, no mutation, emit shape.
Test the new mapping and that absent values are omitted.
Add prodwatch-metrics.mjs to the lean module entry (devdocs freshness check).

preserve.what: Existing mapRecord mappings and null for unmapped records (bin/engine/telemetry-seam.mjs)
